description: RAIN recomputes the clinic's quality picture on every refresh — risk-mix shift, care-gap closure pace, ED concentration — and surfaces what moved before the measure period closes, so the quality program reacts mid-quarter instead of at the report deadline.

Catches the distribution shift no single chart shows — the high tier absorbing weight from monitoring trends and utilization patterns at once — and explains each tier assignment with its top reasons, down to the ranked patient worklist.

Traces every open care gap to its measure, its patient, and the outreach task carrying it, and projects which gaps the scheduling loop closes fastest — the high-tier patients with a bookable slot inside two weeks.

Assembles the board-ready quality report from the conversation — risk mix, closure pace, ED pattern, benchmarks against county baselines — with measure definitions, provenance on every number, and the synthetic-data label on every page.
